text: A woman with long, flowing red hair sits kneeling on stone floor. She has fair skin, orange eyes, and a slender build. Wearing an off-white draped gown tied at waist with blue cord, she sports matching choker and bracelets. Her right hand hovers over glowing pentagram inscribed on the ground. Left arm rests beside her. Hair cascades past shoulders in loose waves. Face is oval-shaped with defined cheekbones. Expression neutral. Background suggests dimly lit chamber with dark furniture.
